summary: Iteration 7 - Tested invitation-based registration with password auth, Tasks CRUD module, and role-specific features. All 20 backend tests passed. All UI tests passed.
passed_tests: ✅ GET /api/invitations/validate/{token} - 404 for invalid token
✅ POST /api/auth/register-with-invite - creates user with password, assigns role from invitation
✅ POST /api/auth/register-with-invite - 404 for invalid token
✅ POST /api/auth/register-with-invite - 400 for email mismatch
✅ POST /api/auth/login - successful login with email/password
✅ POST /api/auth/login - 401 for invalid password
✅ POST /api/auth/login - 401 for non-existent user
✅ GET /api/tasks - lists tasks (empty or with data)
✅ POST /api/tasks - creates task with title, type, priority, staff assignment
✅ POST /api/tasks - 404 for invalid staff ID
✅ GET /api/tasks/my-summary - returns task counts (pending, in_progress, completed)
✅ PUT /api/tasks/{id} - updates task status (pending -> in_progress -> completed)
✅ PUT /api/tasks/{id} - updates task fields (title, priority, description)
✅ GET /api/tasks?status=pending - filters tasks by status
✅ DELETE /api/tasks/{id} - deletes task
✅ DELETE /api/tasks/{id} - 404 for non-existent task
✅ GET /api/staff/my-earnings - 403 for non-staff users (admin restricted)
✅ GET /api/dashboard/kpis - returns role-specific KPIs
✅ GET /api/auth/me - returns current user
✅ GET /api/auth/me - 401 for unauthenticated requests
✅ Frontend: Landing page Sign In button opens login modal
✅ Frontend: Login modal has Google OAuth and email/password options
✅ Frontend: Password login works (email + password -> dashboard)
✅ Frontend: Registration page at /invite/{token} shows correct form fields
✅ Frontend: Registration form has first name, last name, phone, password fields
✅ Frontend: Email is pre-filled and disabled from invitation
✅ Frontend: Registration with password creates user and redirects to dashboard
✅ Frontend: Invalid invitation token shows 'Invalid Invitation' error with 'Go to Home' button
✅ Frontend: Layout header shows 'Hey, {FirstName}' greeting
✅ Frontend: Role badge shows 'Admin' for company_admin
✅ Frontend: Role badge shows 'Staff' for staff users
✅ Frontend: Navigation includes Tasks for admin and staff
✅ Frontend: Staff navigation excludes Invitations (admin-only)
✅ Frontend: Admin can see 'Add Task' button
✅ Frontend: Staff cannot see 'Add Task' button (correctly hidden)
✅ Frontend: Tasks page shows tabs (Pending, In Progress, Completed, All)
✅ Frontend: Staff dashboard shows My Earnings, Tasks Completed, Upcoming Tasks
✅ Audit logging - account_activated events logged with role and method
✅ Audit logging - login events logged with method (password)
critical_code_review_comments: Password hashing uses bcrypt with salt - secure implementation
Email field is disabled in registration form to prevent tampering
Audit logs correctly record account activation and login events
Role-based navigation works correctly (staff sees Tasks, not Invitations)
Staff dashboard shows earnings data specific to staff role
seed_data_creation: Test admin user with company created. Test staff member created for task assignment tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 7 verified: (1) Password-based registration with invitation tokens works - creates user with role from invitation, (2) Password login with email/password works and logs audit events, (3) Tasks CRUD fully functional - create, read, update status, delete tasks, (4) Role-specific dashboards working - staff sees earnings/tasks, admin sees full KPIs, (5) Greeting shows 'Hey, {FirstName}' using first_name field, (6) Role badges correctly show Admin/Owner/Staff, (7) Navigation is role-specific - staff cannot see Invitations, (8) Audit logging works for account_activated and login events.

password_auth.register_with_invite: POST /api/auth/register-with-invite - creates user with password hash

tasks_crud.list: GET /api/tasks - filters by status, staff sees only assigned tasks
tasks_crud.create: POST /api/tasks - admin only, requires staff assignment
tasks_crud.update: PUT /api/tasks/{id} - admin edits all fields, staff only status

audit_logging.account_activated: Logged on registration with role and auth method
audit_logging.login: Logged on password login with auth method
